events.title: Spanish colonists abandon Santa Fe during the Pueblo Revolt
events.description: Besieged by Pueblo fighters led by Popé, the Spanish governor and settlers retreated from Santa Fe towards El Paso. The Pueblo peoples kept New Mexico free of Spanish rule for twelve years.
events.html: Besieged by Pueblo fighters led by Popé, the Spanish governor and settlers retreated from Santa Fe towards El Paso. The Pueblo peoples kept New Mexico free of Spanish rule for twelve years.

events.title: Cameronians repel the Jacobites at Dunkeld
events.description: A small regiment of Cameronians held the town of Dunkeld against a much larger Jacobite force. The defeat broke the momentum of the rising that had followed Killiecrankie.
events.html: A small regiment of Cameronians held the town of Dunkeld against a much larger Jacobite force. The defeat broke the momentum of the rising that had followed Killiecrankie.

events.title: Lincoln and Douglas hold their first debate
events.description: Abraham Lincoln and Senator Stephen Douglas met in Ottawa, Illinois, for the first of seven debates on the spread of slavery. Lincoln lost the Senate race but won national attention.
events.html: Abraham Lincoln and Senator Stephen Douglas met in Ottawa, Illinois, for the first of seven debates on the spread of slavery. Lincoln lost the Senate race but won national attention.

events.title: The Mona Lisa is stolen from the Louvre
events.description: Italian handyman Vincenzo Peruggia walked out of the Louvre with the Mona Lisa under his smock. The theft made the painting world-famous; it was recovered in Florence in 1913.
events.html: Italian handyman Vincenzo Peruggia walked out of the Louvre with the Mona Lisa under his smock. The theft made the painting world-famous; it was recovered in Florence in 1913.

events.title: Hawaii becomes the 50th US state
events.description: President Eisenhower proclaimed Hawaii's admission as the 50th state. It was the first state outside North America and the first with an Asian American plurality.
events.html: President Eisenhower proclaimed Hawaii's admission as the 50th state. It was the first state outside North America and the first with an Asian American plurality.

events.title: Total solar eclipse crosses the United States coast to coast
events.description: The Moon's shadow swept from Oregon to South Carolina, the first total eclipse to cross the whole country since 1918. Tens of millions watched along the path of totality.
events.html: The Moon's shadow swept from Oregon to South Carolina, the first total eclipse to cross the whole country since 1918. Tens of millions watched along the path of totality.
